Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates dextrocardia (heart apex pointing to the right) and a right-sided gastric bubble, indicating situs inversus totalis. Additionally, there are coarse reticular markings and tram-track opacities at the lung bases consistent with bronchiectasis, which together with situs inversus is characteristic of Kartagener’s syndrome.
